known_findings.summary: DummyCodeEncoder builds one global category->column dictionary keyed only by category value. Equal labels in different input features collapse into one output column, causing transform width/feature-name disagreement and inverse_transform failure.

DummyCodeEncoder computes infrequent-category mappings and reports grouped _n_features_outs/get_feature_names_out, but its custom _transform never applies the infrequent mapping. Returned matrices retain separate infrequent columns.
GetDummies documents handle_unknown as {error, ignore}, but fit performs no enum validation; arbitrary values are accepted and act like ignore when unseen categories occur.

Focused test modules claim direct standalone execution/isolation, but the stub/bootstrap code is commented out and direct script execution fails on relative imports. The isolation helper exists but is not activated.
